audit_summary: OECD STES downloads provide latest revised historical series rather than real-time first releases. Because industrial production undergoes substantial revisions (up to 12 months after reference month), using final revised numbers in policy event studies introduces revision/lookahead contamination. Flagged with revised_series = 1 and removed from default v2 controls.
